apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Leaving the app no longer pauses: a tap that lands as you swipe out is undone. Diagnostics now say what caused every pause. Evening rounds after BFR include the 30 s holds and calf raise.
After a BFR morning, the evening round now includes David's 30 s holds and the seated calf raise.
BFR mornings keep David's 30 s wall holds; only the calf raise is skipped.
